description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various aspects of audio analysis in a study. The largest segment, accounting for 41.2%, is dedicated to 'Semantic Layer', followed by 'Cultural Layer' at 14.1%. Other segments include 'Perceptual' at 4.3%, 'Content Analysis' at 3.3%, 'Emotion & Intention' at 2.2%, 'Speaker Analysis' at 1.2%, 'Environmental Perception & Reasoning' at 1.2%, 'Music Theory' at 1.2%, 'Counting & Statistics' at 1.2%, 'Correlation Analysis' at 1.2%, 'Temporal Analysis' at 1.2%, 'Spatial Analysis' at 1.2%, 'Professional Reasoning' at 1.2%, 'Culture of Speaker' at 1.2%, 'Imaginal' at 1.2%, 'Acoustic Quality Analysis' at 1.2%, 'Anomaly Detection' at 1.2%, and 'Audio Difference Analysis' at 1.2%. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any slices that are visually emphasized. The segments are ordered in a clockwise direction starting from the top.
